text:
mia: Heads-up — scheduling a blue->green tilt in eu-west during the 03:00 UTC change window. Plan: 0% -> 25% (5m) -> 60% (10m) -> 100% with canary verification. release tag: release/v2.9.1-shift-98321. Notes: router patch for connection pooling + a KV-cache warmup improvement.

deploy-bot: shift queued by mia. shift_id=shft-98321. Execution plan:
```
rbctl shift apply --id shft-98321 --stepped 25,60,100 --hold 300,600 --meta "eu-west,session-affinity=sticky"
```
Started checks: healthhooks ✅, trace sampling 0.5% ✅, canary probes ✅

leo: quick ask — cache warmup: do we have a prefix pre-seed? last time we saw cold misses at 20% -> latency bump. Suggest pre-warm the top-10k prefixes to reduce p95 noise.

anita: agree with leo. Also will enable graceful-fallback policy so requests can route to green-compatible variant on retry. Add a short-lived header pin for long sessions: `X-Route-Pin: 10m`.

sam: FYI I updated rollout notes in the release doc (docs/releases/v2.9.1.md) and added the metric checks: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 400ms, error-rate < 0.5%. If any threshold breaches, ops should hold/phaseback.

deploy-bot: pre-warm job kicked: job_id=warm-4421, estimated 90s. Will start shift in 2m.

infra-oncall: starting monitoring hook — dashboard: /d/infra/eu-west-shift, alerts to #eng-oncall and #pager. Also enabling short trace sampling to capture tail events.

(2m later)

deploy-bot: shift step -> 25% applied. Timestamp: 2937654360. health: ok.

leo: seeing p95 jump to 610ms and KV cache misses +72% on router-2. Not on all nodes, looks like cold partitions.

anita: hold the shift. deploy-bot — pause and phaseback to 15% to reduce exposure. Also enable the fallback variant for 5m.

deploy-bot: action: pause applied. Rolling phaseback: 25% -> 15%. shift state=paused, rollback_allowed=false. phaseback_done at 2937654375.

mia: thanks. Good call. We'll let warm job finish and then resume with smaller increments: 10% -> 30% -> 60% with 10m holds. Also adding an explicit check for KV-miss delta in the gating script.

sam: capturing timeline for release notes and post-deploy blameless follow-up. Owner for follow-up: anita (cache warmup strategy + router config).

infra-oncall: monitoring shows p95 recovering after phaseback; keeping alerts active for next 20m. If stable, we reschedule larger ramp at +30m.

mia: summary: shift paused and phasebacked to 15% due to cache warmup causing p95 spike. Action items: 
- anita: implement targeted prefix pre-warm and set `X-Route-Pin` on long sessions
- leo: run a quick synthetic session load against router-2 cluster
- sam: update release notes and ops playbook with the gating KV-miss check
- deploy-bot: add an automated phaseback step to the plan for future shifts

:+1: sounds good. We'll reconvene on channel in 25m or earlier if alerts fire.
